theme_strategy.aesthetic: Linear/Notion inspired precision with warm cream/coffee earthy undertones

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, Sidebar Branding, Modal titles, KDS column headers

body.usage: Body text, tables, form fields, badges, POS cart items

mono_numeric.usage: Prices, Order IDs, Total amounts, Quantity counters, Invoice numbers

tailwind_custom_tokens.btn-coffee: bg-[#3D271D] hover:bg-[#2B1A13] text-[#FDFBF7] dark:bg-[#E8C8B5] dark:hover:bg-[#F0D7C7] dark:text-[#1A1412]

spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons, rounded-full for badges/pills
spacing_and_layout.pos_layout: 3-column layout on desktop: Left sidebar nav (w-64), Center categories & products grid (flex-1), Right live cart panel (w-96)
spacing_and_layout.kds_layout: 4-column responsive board (NEW / PREPARING / READY / COMPLETED) with timer indicators and single-click status transitions

routes_and_pages.title: Dashboard
key_elements: KPI Cards: Today's Sales (₹), Today's Orders, Active Tables count, Pending Kitchen Orders
Sales Trend Chart (Hourly & Daily toggles using Recharts)
Recent Live Orders Feed
Low Stock Alerts Widget
Top Selling Products list with sales count
Interactive Active Tables quick status
Quick Action Buttons: New POS Order, Reserve Table, Add Menu Item

routes_and_pages.title: Point of Sale (POS)
key_elements: Category Bar: All, Coffee, Tea, Cold Drinks, Food, Snacks, Desserts
Product Grid: Name, Category, Price, Stock indicator, Add-to-Cart trigger, initial/icon visual
Cart Drawer/Panel: Item list, quantity modifier (+/-), subtotal, discount input, tax (5% GST), total bill
Dine-in / Takeaway / Delivery selector & Table selector
Payment Methods: Cash, UPI (QR preview), Card
Action Buttons: 'Send to Kitchen', 'Pay & Complete', 'Print Invoice'
Modal: Live Printable Receipt / Tax Invoice preview

routes_and_pages.title: Table Management
key_elements: Visual Floor Plan Grid with statuses (Available, Occupied, Reserved)
Table Details Popover: Current order summary, seated time, waiter assigned
Quick Actions: Occupy Table, Reserve Table, Clear Table, Move Order

routes_and_pages.title: Order Management
key_elements: Tabs: All Orders, New, Preparing, Ready, Completed, Cancelled
Search & Filter by Order ID, Customer Phone, Payment Status, Order Type
Order Detail Sheet / Modal with itemized breakdown and status stepper

routes_and_pages.title: Kitchen Display System (KDS)
key_elements: Kanban Board Columns: NEW (Amber), PREPARING (Blue), READY (Green), COMPLETED (Muted)
Real-time Elapsed Timer on each order card (Color turns red if > 15 mins)
Item Checklist with individual mark-done switches
One-tap 'Move to Preparing' and 'Mark Ready' buttons

routes_and_pages.title: Menu Management
key_elements: CRUD Interface: Add/Edit/Delete Menu Items
Category Manager & In-Stock/Out-of-Stock Toggle
Price & GST Tax Rate Configurator

routes_and_pages.title: Inventory Management
key_elements: Ingredient Stock Table with Reorder Levels
Visual Low Stock Alerts (< threshold)
Stock In / Stock Out log entry form

routes_and_pages.title: Customer CRM
key_elements: Customer Directory (Name, Phone, Total Visits, Lifetime Spend, Favorite Drink)
Loyalty Points balance indicator
Add New Customer quick modal

routes_and_pages.title: Staff & Roles
key_elements: Staff List with Role badges: Owner, Manager, Cashier, Kitchen Staff
Permissions Matrix overview
Add Staff Member dialog with PIN/Email access

routes_and_pages.title: Reports & Analytics
key_elements: Sales Revenue Breakdown (Daily/Weekly/Monthly)
Peak Hours Heatmap / Bar Chart
Category Revenue Pie Chart & Export CSV/PDF button

routes_and_pages.title: Subscription & Billing
key_elements: Current Active Plan Banner
Pricing Cards: Café Monthly Plan (₹149/mo) vs Café Yearly Plan (₹1,199/yr - BEST VALUE badge)
Razorpay Mock Checkout Integration dialog
Invoice History table

routes_and_pages.title: Settings
key_elements: Café Profile: Name, Address, GSTIN, Phone, Logo initials
Receipt Printing Header/Footer customization
Tax Config (CGST/SGST/Service Charge)
Theme Preference Toggle (Light / Dark)

routes_and_pages.title: Login & OTP Verification
key_elements: Warm minimal aesthetic login card
Step 1: Enter Email address
Step 2: 6-Digit OTP verification with input-otp component
Demo Credentials auto-fill buttons (Owner / Cashier / Kitchen)

component_strategy.icons: Use lucide-react (Coffee, Utensils, LayoutDashboard, ShoppingBag, Grid, Clock, ChefHat, Package, Users, Shield, BarChart3, CreditCard, Settings, Sun, Moon, Plus, Trash2, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, Printer)
component_strategy.no_product_images: Product cards MUST use stylized initials or warm colored icon badges with subtle gradients/borders instead of photorealistic stock images as specified in PRD
component_strategy.toasts: Sonner toast notifications for order placements, kitchen updates, inventory alerts, and payment receipts

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact color tokens and typography configuration in tailwind and index.css.
Ensure every page route listed in routes_and_pages is fully interactive with rich mock data.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, and navigation items.
Do not use photorealistic product images in POS or Menu; use clean initials badges with category color accenting.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for all key actions (e.g. 'Order #104 Sent to Kitchen', 'Payment Successful', 'Low Stock Alert').
